motion.threeSpeedsBody: All animations come from one of three springs in lib/springs. Hover states and small toggles use fast. Dropdowns and tabs use moderate. Dialogs and drawers use slow. No component invents its own timing, so things move at the same pace. moderate is critically damped: it lands exactly with no overshoot.
motion.slowInFasterOutBody: Both modals open on spring.slow. The only difference is the close: the left exits on spring.slow, the right on spring.slow.exit — one tier faster. That slight drag on the way out is exactly what you are trying to avoid.
motion.allTokensBody: Click a track to see it. The ball enters on the spring, then returns on the exit tween. Everything lives in lib/springs; duration values belong there, not scattered through component code.
motion.reducedMotionBody: All springs respect the OS setting. Wrap the app tree in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user; when reduced motion is enabled, position changes drop out and only opacity fades remain.
